annotations.title: ToolFit: Watch a remote MCP server for tool or grade changes

description:
Hosted watch for a remote MCP server: ToolFit re-audits it for 30 days and POSTs an HMAC-SHA256 signed JSON webhook to your https endpoint when its tools/list fingerprint or grade changes, or it goes unreachable or recovers. tier watch = every 24 h ($0.25 per watch, 30 days), tier watch6h = every 6 h ($0.60 per watch). Leave "every" out (the tier sets it). Returns watch_id and the signing secret once (store it: it verifies webhooks and authorizes watch_status and watch_cancel). Not charged if the server is unreachable, a URL or webhook is blocked, or the watch list is full.

[ToolFit via YourAITools MCP Hub] No free tier (paid route only). Paid: watch $0.25 / watch6h $0.60 per call, with a credits key (Authorization: Bearer yatc_...) or x402 (USDC; the hub returns the payment terms). Failed tool calls aren't charged: credits are refunded automatically and x402 payments only settle on success.

every.description: Optional; this route is the 24 h interval (POST /v1/watch/6h for every 6 h).

tier.description: Paid tier: watch $0.25, watch6h $0.60. Default watch.

url.description: Public remote MCP server URL (Streamable HTTP, https), e.g. https://api.youraitools.co/mcp/hub. ToolFit only lists its tools.

webhook.description: Your https endpoint (public host, port 443) that receives the signed JSON change notifications. A query string is allowed.
